snippet.title: India Grows Faster Than 75% of the World! #geography #maps #india
snippet.description:
Video Transcript:
This is the country where the highest number of children are born every year. And that country is… India, approximately 23 million babies are born there every year. To put it into another perspective, in all of these 146 countries the same number of children is born every year as it is in India. In another perspective, in the USA alone it’s 3.6 million babies per year, while in the European Union it's 3.7 million. This world comparison is crazy.

Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_number_of_births

snippet.description:

snippet.title: Greatest Investment Returns Comparison
snippet.description:
We compare the average yearly return of some popular investments from their date of inception to today. We will compare gold, silver, oil, commodities, and even popular stocks from Apple to Tesla. We will even compare how those investments such as the Ferrari 250 GTO, from around a $15,000 purchase in 1960s to a $70 million sold in 2018, and the Salvador Mundi, an under $100 initial investment to a whopping $450 million, stack up against these common purchases. 

Note: Yearly calculation are based on the earliest available sources listed below. The figures are not adjusted for inflation. This video merely states the statistics of historical data and is for educational and entertainment purposes only. Past gains may not represent future gains. 

Sources: https://pastebin.com/5T69Tj2k

snippet.title: Germans almost got America...🇩🇪🤯
snippet.description:
#Germany #German #GermanEmpire #Imperialgermany #Germanyhistory #Empire #ww1 #worldwar1 #Europe #europegeography #EuropeanCountries #unitedkingdom #Switzerland #Austria #czechia  #poland #Russia #Filnand #USA #America #Americanhistory #usahistory #World #worldmap  #comparison #facts #geography #geopolitics #population #gdp #military #maps 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Did you know the Germans once tried to invade America.
in the first plan German warships would sail to the USA, destroy many ports on the East Coast, then the Kaiser would negotiate 2 ports from the US president, however then USA wiped the floor with Spain and took Puerto Rico, so the Kaiser had to reconsider the plan,
second plan was deadlier as 60 warships and 60 cargo ships carrying 100 thousand troops would shell Boston, then take both Boston and New York, however the Kaiser’s ships weren’t enough for 100 thousand troops,
3rd plan was also made, however by 1904 France and the UK became buddies while Russia rejected Germany, so Kaiser had to focus on a possible European conflict,

Did you know China almost colonized the world Long before the Europeans.
during the 1400s Europeans were struggling while China was in its golden age and discovering things. Moreover under this dude's leadership China was the literal best in shipbuilding and navigation, meaning that if it had colonized Oceania and Americas most of the world would be speaking Chinese today.
However when Zeng He passed, Chinese emperors stopped oversea voyages focusing more on their inland empires. Sadly for China Europeans discovered this glitch and now we all speak European languages.
